name_vi: Túi hộp giày du lịch hai ngăn
description_en: An elongated woven shoe carrier with two divided textile compartments and a clamshell zipper rim. Canonical front: a woven rectangular lid and short central handle. Side view: a deep tapered wall with zipper and leather vent trim. Rear view: two woven base panels separated by a reinforced center spine. All panels, linings, hardware and inserts are completely unmarked; no text, logos, symbols or labels. Keep the identical structure, materials and attachments across all three views.
prompt: Use case: product-mockup. Create ONE original photorealistic Vietnamese rattan/bamboo studio catalog product. Subject: An elongated woven shoe carrier with two divided textile compartments and a clamshell zipper rim. Canonical front: a woven rectangular lid and short central handle. Side view: a deep tapered wall with zipper and leather vent trim. Rear view: two woven base panels separated by a reinforced center spine. All panels, linings, hardware and inserts are completely unmarked; no text, logos, symbols or labels. Keep the identical structure, materials and attachments across all three views.. Style Modern: clean contemporary geometry. Relative size generous within its class, no measurements. Main woven surfaces: close herringbone V-shaped twill. Finish: deep walnut-brown dye with visible fiber grain. Believable smooth bindings, continuous strips, stable wood/bamboo frame and only specified plain secondary materials. All interiors empty. CAMERA: exact straight-on FRONT ELEVATION at azimuth zero, directly facing its described front feature, level with product center. No three-quarter or overhead angle. This is the canonical FRONT image for subsequent views of the same design. Whole object visible, centered with generous margins. Plain warm-white seamless studio backdrop, soft lighting and subtle shadow, sharp fiber texture. Square image. No props, room, people, animals, food, plants, detached extra products, collage, diagram or border. ABSOLUTELY NO TEXT ANYWHERE: no letters, numbers, words, symbols, labels, logos, captions, watermarks, measurements or inscriptions.
